def choose_move(observation):
    width = observation.get('width', 0)
    height = observation.get('height', 0)
    own_pos = observation.get('players', {}).get('own', {}).get('pos', [0, 0])
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    enemies = observation.get('players', {}).get('enemies', [])
    territory_control = observation.get('territory', {}).get('owner', [])
    
    x, y = own_pos

    dx, dy = 0, 0

    # Resource collection: move towards a resource if adjacent
    for r in resources:
        rx, ry = r
        dist = abs(rx - x) + abs(ry - y)
        if dist == 1:
            return [rx - x, ry - y]
        elif dist > 1:
            dx_candidate = 1 if rx > x else -1 if rx < x else 0
            dy_candidate = 1 if ry > y else -1 if ry < y else 0
            return [dx_candidate, dy_candidate]

    # Pursuit or evasion: move towards the nearest enemy if adjacent
    for enemy in enemies:
        ex, ey = enemy.get('pos', [0, 0])
        dist = abs(ex - x) + abs(ey - y)
        if dist == 1:
            return [ex - x, ey - y]
        elif dist > 1:
            dx_candidate = 1 if ex > x else -1 if ex < x else 0
            dy_candidate = 1 if ey > y else -1 if ey < y else 0
            return [dx_candidate, dy_candidate]

    # Territory control: move towards unowned or enemy territory
    for idx, owner in enumerate(territory_control):
        if owner != 'own':
            tx = idx % width
            ty = idx // width
            dist = abs(tx - x) + abs(ty - y)
            if dist == 1:
                return [tx - x, ty - y]
            elif dist > 1:
                dx_candidate = 1 if tx > x else -1 if tx < x else 0
                dy_candidate = 1 if ty > y else -1 if ty < y else 0
                return [dx_candidate, dy_candidate]

    # No cues: prefer moving towards center if possible to stay more balanced
    center_x, center_y = width // 2, height // 2
    dx_candidate = 1 if center_x > x else -1 if center_x < x else 0
    dy_candidate = 1 if center_y > y else -1 if center_y < y else 0
    # Make move only if within bounds
    new_x, new_y = x + dx_candidate, y + dy_candidate
    if 0 <= new_x < width and 0 <= new_y < height:
        return [dx_candidate, dy_candidate]
    # Else stay put
    return [0, 0]
